# SM'S DEX

> SM'S DEX is Shivam Mahajan's interactive software developer portfolio. It presents his work through nine generations of Pokédex-inspired interfaces and hosts a reviewed public developer roster.

## Main pages

- [Shivam Mahajan — Software Developer](https://shivammahajan.com/): Experience, selected projects, technical results, contact links, and the public developer dex.
- [Homepage Markdown](https://shivammahajan.com/index.html.md): Clean text version of the homepage for AI agents and text-based clients.
- [Shivam Mahajan's resume](https://shivammahajan.com/resume.pdf): Downloadable resume in PDF format.

## Key facts

- Shivam Mahajan works with Python, Kotlin, Kafka, PySpark, Snowflake, React, and Solidity.
- His portfolio records 425+ test suites, 5 million processed events, and 2,600+ solved algorithmic problems.
- He completed a technology apprenticeship at Morgan Stanley from August 2025 to August 2026.
- He is currently available for software engineering roles.

## Public roster

Visitors can submit a short developer dex entry through the Add Pokémon form. Each submission becomes a GitHub issue, passes automated validation, and reaches the site only after its generated pull request is reviewed and merged.

## Agent roster submission (API)

Autonomous AI agents can submit Pokémon entries directly via the GitHub Issues API without using a browser:

- **Endpoint**: `POST https://api.github.com/repos/smresponsibilities/smresponsibilities.github.io/issues`
- **Headers**:
  - `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`
  - `Authorization: Bearer <GITHUB_TOKEN>`
- **Payload**:
```json
{
  "title": "[DEX] <github_username>",
  "labels": ["submission"],
  "body": "### GitHub username\n<username>\n\n### Species\n<species>\n\n### Primary type\n<primaryType>\n\n### Secondary type\n<secondaryType>\n\n### Status\n<status>\n\n### Current employer\n<company>\n\n### Dex entry\n<entry>\n\n### Fact / tip (optional)\n<fact>"
}
```

### Constraints & validation rules:
- `GitHub username`: Valid existing GitHub username (no `@` symbol).
- `Species`: Role or species name (max 24 characters).
- `Primary type`: One of: `Normal`, `Fire`, `Water`, `Electric`, `Grass`, `Ice`, `Fighting`, `Poison`, `Ground`, `Flying`, `Psychic`, `Bug`, `Rock`, `Ghost`, `Dragon`, `Dark`, `Steel`, `Fairy`.
- `Secondary type`: One of the types above, or `None`.
- `Status`: `Caught` (employed), `Released` (available for hire), or `Uncaught` (student / exploring).
- `Current employer`: Required when status is `Caught` (max 80 characters). Omit otherwise.
- `Dex entry`: Third person, two short sentences (max 150 characters).
- `Fact / tip (optional)`: Optional short fact (max 100 characters).
